dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite-pool, recorded-realization estimand is stated coherently, and the printed decompositions check: -0.0314-(-0.2541)=+0.2227 and -0.0875-(-0.0800)=-0.0075. However, neither the score construction nor any item-level, treatment, or decode record is available, so the empirical inputs and semantic interpretation of the central cross-level quantity cannot be verified.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The four-page paper is well organized, candid about its evidence boundary, readable, anonymous, and ICLR-formatted. Tables clearly distinguish natural strata from paired filler. Presentation is limited by opaque evidence IDs and a central score whose operational definition is unavailable; the rounding caveat for Table 3 is also separated from the table it qualifies.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The strongest supported contribution is a clear formalization of what the reported paired number would estimate conditional on a named finite pool and one recorded decode realization. This is useful corrective framing, but it is a narrow audit of an inaccessible source record rather than independently substantiated empirical knowledge or a new general method.

paper_summary: This paper audits two source-reported masked-diffusion records: a natural-strata +0.2227 score–outcome difference and a separate 400-item, fixed-37-token-filler paired contrast of -0.0075 at reported NFE=64. It formalizes the latter as a finite-pool, single-recorded-decode descriptive estimand and expressly declines causal, calibration, decoder-expectation, and cross-record inferences because the underlying artifacts are absent.
strongest_verified_contribution: A precise and appropriately limited separation between (i) algebra and printed arithmetic that can be checked from the submission and (ii) empirical quantities that remain source-reported/cannot-verify; in particular, the paper correctly avoids comparing the natural-strata and paired-filler values as a common estimand.
strengths: The paper has an unusually explicit evidence boundary: all empirical values are labeled SR/CV, and the missing treatment, sample, score, trace, and implementation artifacts are concretely enumerated (pp. 1–2, Sections 1–2).
The estimand in Section 3 appropriately conditions on both the finite pool P and a recorded realization ω, making the single-decode semantic limit clear.
The narrative and Table 1 prevent a common interpretive error: the natural-strata record and paired-filler record are presented as different samples and estimands, not endpoints to compare.

The printed numerical accounting is internally consistent at the level claimed. Table 2 verifies +0.2227 from the displayed components; Table 3's separately reported component contrasts yield -0.0075.
The PDF is anonymous, has four total pages including references, uses the ICLR under-review header, has no identifiable author material, and includes an AI-assistance disclosure (p. 3, Section 6).
questions: Can an anonymized, stable crosswalk for A32-E1/A32-E2 be released, together with the item manifests, serialized prompts, arm rows, and decode/analysis artifacts needed to independently reconstruct the two reported records?

What exact token-level quantity is s_{iaω}, how is it aggregated to an item score, and what event does it forecast? Without this, what reader-facing interpretation beyond a symbolic signed summary is intended?

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Section 1, paragraphs beginning “The central quantity” and “Measurement status”; PDF p. 2, Section 3, definition of s_{iaω}; reviewer-safe method provenance A32-M1.
issues.observed_evidence: The paper defines s_{iaω} only as a “source-recorded commit score.” The supplied provenance record states that the trace is not located and that token-to-answer aggregation and forecast-event semantics cannot be verified. The manuscript responsibly says it is not verified as a probability of final-answer correctness, but the exact score/readout remains unavailable.
issues.why_it_matters: The central quantity subtracts final-answer correctness from a score measured at another level. Without an operational definition, readers cannot determine its range, aggregation, direction, or substantive meaning; algebra alone does not establish that the reported statistic addresses a meaningful calibration-related question.
issues.required_fix: Provide the score/readout specification and a reproducible token-to-item aggregation path, or further narrow the paper so the quantity is explicitly a generic opaque-record audit with no implied measurement interpretation.
issues.verification_test: An independent reviewer should be able to apply the supplied score definition and aggregation code to a released decode trace, reproduce an item score, and confirm the tabled arm means from item-level rows.
issues.evidence_needed: Commit-score definition, gate/readout implementation, token-to-answer aggregation rule, and at least one reproducible trace-to-row example; full rows are needed to verify the reported means.

issues.location: PDF p. 2, Section 2 “What is missing”; PDF p. 3, Section 4.2 and Table 3; reviewer-safe experiment registry A32-X1/A32-X2 and repository inventory.
issues.observed_evidence: The snapshot contains no experimental records, stable evidence-ID-to-file crosswalk, manifests, prompts, filler string, pairing rows, labels, traces, model/tokenizer revision, decoder configuration, or analysis code. Accordingly, all empirical values, the reported 400-item pool, treatment fidelity, and different-sample boundary are source-reported/cannot-verify.
issues.why_it_matters: The paper accurately reports this limitation, but its principal empirical anchors remain inaccessible assertions. The audit can establish only the conditional formal target and transcription arithmetic, not whether the source measurements or intervention correspond to their descriptions.
issues.required_fix: Release a reviewer-safe anonymized evidence bundle or a stable archival reference that permits reconstruction of the two records, including an overlap map that substantiates the distinct-sample statement.
issues.verification_test: Recompute Tables 2 and 3 from the released rows; verify the 400-item paired manifest, filler token dose and insertion rule, arm pairing, and natural-strata membership/overlap map.
issues.evidence_needed: Immutable manifests and exclusions, prompts/filler and tokenizer check, per-item arm records with scores and labels, decode configuration/traces, analysis code, and a crosswalk from A32-E1/A32-E2 to those files.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Section 1 “Measurement status”; PDF p. 2, Table 1; reviewer-safe repository inventory “Not located.”
issues.observed_evidence: A32-E1 and A32-E2 are repeatedly used as evidence labels, but the paper and supplied inventory state that they are opaque references to unavailable records and that no stable ID-to-file crosswalk exists. “The source” is therefore not operationally identifiable to the reader.
issues.why_it_matters: The labels efficiently mark uncertainty, yet they resemble auditable evidence identifiers while providing no retrieval path. This makes it harder to distinguish a well-provenanced inaccessible artifact from an unsupported verbal report.
issues.required_fix: Add a short provenance statement specifying the source type, custodian/access status, date/version, and an anonymized stable locator or explicitly rename the labels as unavailable source-report identifiers.
issues.verification_test: A reader can use the stated locator/crosswalk to identify the frozen source artifact and determine whether it contains the reported summaries, without learning author identity.
issues.evidence_needed: An anonymized archival identifier, source-version metadata, and ID-to-artifact crosswalk.

issues.location: PDF p. 3, Table 3 and the paragraph immediately following it.
issues.observed_evidence: Table 3 displays score means rounded to three decimals (0.630 and 0.543) but a four-decimal score contrast of -0.0875. The following paragraph explains that unrounded means could yield this contrast, but the qualification is not attached to the relevant table cell.
issues.why_it_matters: A reader checking the table visually obtains -0.087 rather than -0.0875 and may initially suspect an arithmetic error. The text resolves this, but the important semantic status of the contrast is easy to miss.
issues.required_fix: Place a table footnote beside the score contrast stating that it was source-reported from unrounded values and is not expected to equal subtraction of the displayed rounded means; ideally display consistent precision when supported.
issues.verification_test: At normal reading order, a reader can identify the source of the apparent precision mismatch from Table 3 alone and does not infer a numerical inconsistency.
issues.evidence_needed: Either unrounded arm means/item rows or an explicit source-report/rounding note in the table.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, privacy, or deployment harm is established in the frozen material. The paper appropriately avoids claims that could overstate an unverified calibration or causal result.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control, using only the frozen submission snapshot and no external browsing or prior-round material.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A reviewer-safe reproducibility bundle that independently reproduces Tables 2–3 and verifies the 400-item paired treatment, rows, and distinct-sample/overlap boundary.
An exact definition and implementation of the commit score, including token-to-answer aggregation and its semantic relationship to the final-answer event.
A broader, verified literature search specifically covering prompt length/filler interventions and masked-diffusion uncertainty, followed by a precise update to the novelty boundary.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Evidence that the claimed 37-token fixed-filler treatment, pairing, NFE=64 configuration, or 400-item pool was not executed as described.
Evidence that the score direction, aggregation, or final-answer matcher differs from the notation used in the estimand.
Evidence that the natural-strata and paired records were selectively filtered or share an unreported sample relationship that contradicts the stated boundary.
review_limitations: I could verify only manuscript text, supplied reviewer-safe evidence summaries, and arithmetic derived from printed source-reported values; I could not inspect missing raw records or rerun any experiment.
I did not perform external literature search or citation verification beyond the supplied citation lock, as required by the isolated-review instructions.
